about: The chain's program. bin/pr-chain loads this file and runs it (pr-chain/chain_engine.py): start at `start`, run each node's `do` step, follow `next[outcome]` to the next node or an end state. Change the order, the routing, a limit, a label or a role here and the chain changes; a new kind of step needs one function in pr-chain/chain_steps.py. See ENGINE.md. Any limit or budget set to -1 means no limit.

labels.chain/resting: pr-chain paused this PR; it retries on its own (see the PR's last verdict)
labels.chain/stuck: pr-chain stopped: same area keeps failing; a new push restarts it
labels.chain/needs-person: pr-chain gave up; remove this label to let it try again

drift_tries.what: times one stage folds main in again

land_fix_cap.what: landing fixes per head on an approved PR

land_tries.what: times resume lands a LAND-STOPPED PR again per head

retry_cap.what: runs ending in a machine-caused state per head

rest_stop.what: rests across all heads before the redesign agent

rest_hours_max.what: rest back-off doubles 1, 2, 4 hours up to this many

head_min_age_minutes.what: a head someone else pushed is left alone this long

prs_at_once.what: PRs the chain works on at once; one stays in focus through its CI waits until it merges or parks on a person or a rest

max_open_prs.what: the builder opens no new PR while this many chain PRs are open; CI is shared, so more PRs only lengthen the queue

stuck_lifts_max.what: times a new push lifts STUCK before NEEDS-PERSON

ci_wait_max_minutes.what: minutes a head may wait for CI before the review; then a fixer gets it

max_steps.what: nodes one run may enter before it ends as ERROR (no flow can loop forever)

agent_timeout_minutes.what: minutes one agent may run before it is killed; -1 = no timeout

round.why: round cap: no audited PASS after {limit} rounds; the last fix is pushed and not reviewed yet; nothing to do by hand, the loop runs this PR again once its head is 45 min old

drift.why: main moved {count} times before a review could start; rerun the chain

MERGED.then: worktrees cleaned, human-approved and chain/* labels removed

READY.means: review and gate passed, run had no --land

BATCH-READY.means: approved at the audited head; waits for a merge-flow batch
BATCH-READY.then: resume lands it in a batch PR; a new push runs the chain again

AWAIT-HUMAN.then: label human-approved lands it, a comment goes to a fixer

WAITING-CI.then: slot freed; resume continues when none is pending

RESTING.label: chain/resting
RESTING.means: agents could not finish this run
RESTING.then: back after the rest back-off; a new head resets the back-off

MAIN-MOVING.means: main moved too often for a stage to start

NO-VERDICT.means: agent wrote no PASS or FAIL

UI-NO-VERDICT.means: UI agent wrote no PASS or FAIL

CI-RED.then: retried; red tests go to a fixer first

CI-TIMEOUT.means: checks did not finish in 45 minutes

CI-HEAD-MOVED.means: the head kept moving while CI ran
CI-HEAD-MOVED.then: parked until the head moves again

HOLD-UI.means: listed as retryable in the code, nothing sets it today

LAND-STOPPED.then: PR goes back to draft, resume retries when the PR changes

STUCK.label: chain/stuck
STUCK.means: rest_stop rests and redesign_tries redesigns, same area keeps failing
STUCK.then: one comment and one design issue; a real new push lifts it

NEEDS-PERSON.label: chain/needs-person
NEEDS-PERSON.means: STUCK was lifted stuck_lifts_max times and came back each time
NEEDS-PERSON.then: waits until a person removes the label

POLICY-HOLD.means: only fix breaks a project rule, or the PR declares a hold

NOT-OURS.means: author is not a configured chain author

STOPPED.then: every chain stops after its stage

DRY.means: --dry-run stopped after the first review launch line

rounds.scope: per run, starts at 1; a run that parks for CI before its review saves its round and last findings, and the next run goes on from there

when_hit.label: chain/resting
when_hit.github: label added; verdict comments already posted stay
when_hit.comes_back: after the rest back-off; the next run starts at round 1

same_findings.rule: the same files named in the findings two rounds in a row

when_hit.label: chain/resting
when_hit.comes_back: after the rest back-off; audits start at 0 again

when_hit.label: chain/resting
when_hit.comes_back: after the rest back-off; the next run's fixer takes the last UI findings first

rests_at_head.scope: per head, a new head starts at 0

when_hit.label: chain/resting
when_hit.comes_back: 1, 2, 4, then 8 hours, and 8 hours from then on

rest_total.scope: per PR, all heads; reset by a landed redesign, a lifted STUCK or a released NEEDS-PERSON
rest_total.at_2: every review is told all past findings are one class and must FAIL unless the class is closed

when_hit.comes_back: a landed redesign resets rest_total to 0 and the loop carries on

redesigns.scope: per PR, reset by a lifted STUCK

when_hit.label: chain/stuck
when_hit.github: label, one comment saying why and how to restart, one issue 'Design needed: #N keeps failing review in the same area' (label bug, filed once per PR)
when_hit.comes_back: a new push that is more than a merge of main lifts STUCK and resets rest_total, rests and redesigns

when_hit.label: chain/needs-person
when_hit.comes_back: only when a person removes the chain/needs-person label; every counter starts over

when_hit.label: chain/needs-person
when_hit.comes_back: a new head, or a person removes the label
next lap, at most retry_cap times per head

when_hit.status: a fixer gets 'required checks never finished'
when_hit.github: the fixer's push if it finds the cause
when_hit.comes_back: the fixer's new head waits for CI again; a fixer that cannot fix it rests

ci_reruns.rule: one rerun of failed jobs for a flaky or main-also-red check

when_hit.comes_back: red tests go to a fixer next run

auto.does: pick the first eligible PR, else the first free issue, else scout
reads: PR author is a configured chain author

pick_issue.does: choose an open issue nobody works on
reads: needs one of: bug, status/ready-for-agent, status/accepted
skips: wontfix, duplicate, invalid, question, status/blocked, status/needs-info, status/needs-repro, status/ready-for-human

scout.does: file new bug issues, then the run ends

build_pr.does: red test first, then the fix, local checks on the Mac; the script pushes and opens a DRAFT PR. It does not wait for GitHub CI

intake._note: auto, issue building and scout still run from Python; the engine runs one PR's chain (phase 2 moves these in)
